DREAD DAWN CO-OP - WHAT IS SYNCHRONISED?   (version 1.2)
Format:  No. Topic  |  single player  ->  co-op
[NEW] = new or improved in version 1.2.

CONNECTION & MENU
 1. Main menu | Continue/New Game/Load/... -> also "Host co-op" and "Join co-op"
    (dialog: name, IP, port 7777; the host sees his Radmin IP 26.x).
 2. Joining | - -> the host saves and sends his whole world; the guest loads it into Save\coop
    (the guest's own saves stay untouched) and stands next to the host.
 3. Settings | each his own -> the host's difficulty and number of zombies count for both
    (only during the session, not saved on the guest's PC).
 4. Versions | - -> the same game and mod version are needed, otherwise rejected with a message.
 5. [NEW] Texts | - -> the mod speaks English; with the German language pack installed German.

PLAYERS
 6. Seeing each other | - -> the other player's figure with walking/running/jumping/falling, aim,
    weapon in hand, shot/hit animation, muzzle flash + weapon sound, flashlight.
    [NEW] Much smoother over the internet: movement is replayed with the sender's timing
    (VPN lines deliver in bursts), the legs walk in the walking direction, short stalls no
    longer switch between walking and standing, falls play once.
 7. Name above the head | - -> name + small health bar above the partner, "(dead)" when dead.
    Own name off by default (showOwnName=true in coop.properties).
 8. [NEW] Partner on the map | - -> yellow dot on the minimap (stays on the rim when far away)
    and on the big map; off screen a yellow arrow with name and distance points to him.
 9. Look | story: Jack / survival: chosen character -> host as usual, the guest gets his own
    random look (saved), so you can tell each other apart.
10. Guest's character | - -> bag, equipment, health/hunger/thirst/stamina, level/XP belong to the
    guest and are saved in the host's save (back on the next join). Starting kit like in
    single player per mode (survival: a starting melee weapon + flashlight, Zombie Escape: the
    mode's loadout + first aid kit + 2 magazines, story/director: baseball bat, M-1911 + 24
    rounds, flashlight, 2 bread, soda), only on the very first join into this host's world.
    All progress of the guest is kept through every map change: armour, sleep, kills,
    weapon/melee/body levels, unlocked recipes and skills.
    [NEW] The guest's character is sent at once when his bag changes, before he goes down and
    with every map change (also when he is dead), so nothing gets lost.
11. Damage to players | only the player -> each manages his own health; hits of zombies,
    bandits, explosions, fire and acid on the guest are calculated by the host.
12. XP / kills | the player gets XP for kills -> the guest too (own XP, own level).
13. No friendly fire | - -> players cannot hurt each other.
14. Bullets | - -> every bullet of the other machine (players, NPCs, turrets) flies as a visible
    tracer, stops at walls/zombies with sparks/blood; damage counts once.
15. Speech bubbles | - -> sentences above heads (NPCs, story, players) are seen by both.

DOWN, DEATH, REVIVE  [NEW]
16. Down | death screen -> at 0 health the player goes down and lies on the ground. Above the body
    a 15 s countdown, the partner sees "[E] Revive" next to him and revives him with E
    (he gets up with 30 % health). Without help he is dead after 15 s.
17. Dead | - -> the dead player watches his partner (camera follows him) and can open the map.
    His body can never be looted. He comes back at the next map change (with his whole bag)
    or when a cutscene starts.
18. Nobody standing | - -> both down/dead (or a mission failed): the normal death screen, the host
    presses Space -> last autosave, the guest loads with him.
19. Fixed: a dead host never came back (now on map change / cutscene); a dead host could jump but
    not walk after a save or cutscene; a dead host lost his bag when the guest changed the map.

ZOMBIES & PEOPLE
20. Zombies | local -> only the host simulates them (spawns, AI, attacks, hordes); the guest sees
    all zombies near him 20x/s with speed prediction.
21. Zombies hunt both | only the player -> zombies chase and attack both players.
22. The guest hits zombies | - -> hits show at once on the guest, damage is applied by the host ->
    the zombie dies the same for both. Burning zombies burn on the guest too.
23. Zombie AI near the guest | only near the player's screen -> the area around the guest is
    simulated by the host exactly like his own screen, however far apart you are (same map).
24. NPC people | local -> only the host simulates them; the guest sees them with weapons, shots and
    sentences; the guest's hits on NPCs go to the host.
25. Trading | - -> the guest trades with traders and survivors himself (buy, sell, repair); the
    trader's stock is the same for both.
26. Companions | - -> the guest can hire (from level 2 like in single player), dismiss, command in
    command mode (Q: storm, go to, follow, hold, fire at will on/off) and use the companion menu
    (C). Companions belong to the player who hired or last commanded them.
    [NEW] The guest's companions travel along when the host changes the map.
27. [NEW] Command mode (Q) and build mode for the guest | - -> the guest's own figure walks to the
    hold point / build site like in single player (it used to walk away and building failed).
28. Grenades, stones, molotovs, smoke, flamethrower, acid | local -> thrown by one, seen by both;
    damage by the host.
29. Explosions, barrels, boomer gas | local -> seen by both, damage counts once.
30. Traps | local -> blade, nail, mine and log traps hurt only once.
    [NEW] The other player's figure never sets off traps.
31. Flame jets | only on the player's screen -> burn when only the guest stands in front of them.
32. RC cars and skateboards | local -> the driver steers himself, the other sees it smoothly.
33. Chickens | local -> state from the host (4x/s).

STORY & MISSIONS
34. Cutscenes | - -> run for both at the same time (same camera, each in his own language).
    Skipping (Space/arrow right) only when BOTH pressed.
    [NEW] The guest no longer misses cutscenes after map changes: the story waits until the
    guest has loaded the new map (max. 45 s) and then starts the scene for both. "Watch or skip
    this scene?" is not asked in co-op (both watch, skipping works by voting).
35. Story dialogs | - -> for both; the next line comes only when both pressed Space.
    [NEW] Skipping the prologue closes the dialog for the guest too.
36. Story pictures, hints, sounds | - -> for both.
37. Story & missions | - -> the host leads the story; the guest sees the same objective. Story
    goals and map events can be triggered by the guest too; rewards and rests for both.
38. Yellow guidance arrow, mission list, zombie area, air drop, camp siege | - -> for both.

WORLD
39. Time of day & weather | local -> the host decides, the guest follows every second.
40. Sleeping | time jumps 7 hours -> only when BOTH slept (within one minute).
41. Map changes | - -> always together. Very frequent (every building is a map of its own).
    [NEW] The guest is told at once when the host leaves; his open containers close, so nothing
    is put into a box that is already gone.
42. Items on the ground | local -> picked up / dropped by both, visible to both.
43. Boxes, cupboards, bodies, air drops | loot rolled on opening -> only the host rolls;
    opened containers have the same contents for both, live.
    [NEW] Reworked: the guest's changes are merged slot by slot into the host's box (nothing is
    overwritten), updates never arrive while an item is being dragged, items are no longer lost.
44. Locks, keys, doors, power lines | local -> for both.
45. Building & tearing down, trees, harvesting, bonfires, feeding & watering, rain barrels | local
    -> for both.

PAUSE & SAVING
46. Pause menu / inventory open | world pauses -> the world keeps running (otherwise the other
    player would freeze). The story waits while the host has a picture, message or inventory open.
47. Saving | the player saves -> the host saves (autosave, F5, slots).
    [NEW] The guest can save for the host (F5 or "Save" in his pause menu): the host saves into
    the slot he loaded or saved last, otherwise the autosave. A dead host can save too; a save
    made while dead stores him alive next to his partner.
48. Disconnection | - -> the host plays on and waits; the guest returns to the main menu.

GENERAL CHANGES
49. "Low FPS" warning (closes the game) | active -> off in co-op.
50. Mouse cursor jump after cutscenes (the game moves the real mouse) | active -> always off.
51. Crash guard | an error while drawing stops the game -> the error is caught.
52. Mini-games | PC games, football, car race, girlfriend scene -> blocked in co-op (they switch to
    a map of their own, the other player would be alone); a message says so.

NOT SYNCHRONISED (known limits)
 - Zombies appear on the guest with about 50-100 ms delay (hardly visible thanks to prediction).
 - Rope, taser and fire hose: only the user sees them; tying up a zombie only works for the host.
 - Fishing: each player fishes for himself.
